title: A bank's internal audit head pushes back — 'a strong organizational ethos should not be confused with a strong control environment'
summary: Mallari runs internal audit at Bank of Commerce. He accepts financial gravity and the mission-guardian idea, then asks who holds the guardians accountable when a regulated bank's duties to its depositors cannot be subordinated to a mission, however well meant.
blockquote: However, a strong organizational ethos should not be confused with a strong control environment. When people become too convinced of their mission, questioning decisions or unintended consequences can be mistaken for a lack of commitment. There must still be room for disagreement.
attribution_title: Vice President and IT Audit Head, Bank of Commerce
